title: Fix Print Compilation
description: Fix print compilation for zwischenbericht mit bestand and all other broken parts.
summary:
Fixed print compilation failures for zwischenbericht mit bestand and all templates.

Root cause: `\SemioTableRegisterRow` ran dot-counting and `\dimen0` assignments outside `\SemioTableRow`, breaking tabular context and causing `Misplaced \noalign` in table of contents and register lists.

Fix: moved indent calculation into `\semio@table@register@indent` inside the row cells.

Verified: `bun ./script.ts build zwischenbericht`, mit-bestand bericht build, and full `print:test` (12 template PDFs).
